author: Vox
description:
After a teenager died this summer during a horse-drawn carriage ride in New York City — and following long-standing protests by animal rights activists against the tourist activity — Mayor Zohran Mamdani and City Council Speaker Julie Menin said they plan to end horse-drawn carriage rides by June 2028. It’s part of a larger trend to get rid of the outdated practice.

author: Vox
description:
Michigan Senator Elissa Slotkin says Democrats’ desire for new faces and bold ideas leaves little room for another Kamala Harris presidential run. Speaking with Astead Herndon, she explains why she thinks familiar candidates will struggle to win over voters in 2028. Watch the full video on Vox’s YouTube on Monday, October 19.
